name: STIHL MSA 300 C-O
blurb: Battery saw. 3/8″ PICCO Super 3, .050″ gauge: 50 drive links on 14″, 55 on 16″ (63 PS3), per STIHL's 2025 chart.
intro: The MSA 300 C-O is a battery saw. STIHL's 2025 chart lists the same two loops it lists for the MSA 220 C-B: 63 PS3, 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 50 drive links on a 14″ bar (3005 000 4809) and 55 on a 16″ bar (3005 008 4813). PS3 is the low-kickback PICCO Super chain. A 63 PM3 loop with the same count fits the same pitch, gauge and drive-link count, but the chart's recommended chain is PS3.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PS3 50 with recommended bar 3005 000 4809. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO Super 3 (63 PS3).
STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PS3 55 with recommended bar 3005 008 4813. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO Super 3 (63 PS3).

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pages 166–167), including the file table and the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pp. 166–167), read 5 Nov 2026. File size from that catalog's file table (4.0 mm / 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO).
